transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because for over a year now, I’ve been trying to get someone to actually take my situation seriously. At work, they started this new ticket rotation and these security audits. I know they're being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps pulling me in, showing me the system logs, and saying it’s just the new policy, but... I know what I'm seeing. I just want someone to finally listen to what's going on.
Do you believe for certain that your management is deliberately building a case against you?

Yes, I do. I mean, I'm absolutely certain. Like I was saying, it's been going on for over a year now. Management keeps pulling up the system logs and telling me it's just the new policy, but... I know what I'm looking at. I've been doing computer support a long time. The way they changed the ticket rotation, and these constant security audits... they are definitely using them to build a paper trail to get rid of me. There's just no other explanation for it.
Has anything happened that made you believe your management can do something impossible, like read your thoughts or control events around you?

Read my thoughts? No. No, nothing like that. I'm not saying they have superpowers or anything. They're just... they're just managers. They can't do the impossible. 

What they're doing is very real, and very grounded in how the IT department operates. They're just manipulating the ticket system and the security audits to make me look bad. They don't need to read my mind to do that, they just need to control the paper trail.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was there?
No, I haven't heard any voices. Nothing like that. It's just the things I'm seeing at work with the system logs and the audits. There aren't any voices involved.
Even before this happened at work, did you generally find it hard to trust other people?

No, not really. I mean, I've always been pretty normal when it comes to that. I trust my family, my friends... I never had any issues trusting people before this whole thing started at the office. This is different. This is about what I'm actually seeing them do.
Have you had any major medical or neurological illness or head injury around the time this started?

No, nothing like that. I haven't had any head injuries or big medical problems. My health is fine. I'm 60, so you know, the usual aches and pains, but nothing major. Definitely no neurological issues or anything that would mess with my head. I'm completely healthy in that regard.
Aside from this situation at work, have you been functioning pretty normally in the rest of your life?

Yeah, I'd say so. Outside of this whole issue with the ticket rotation and the audits, everything else is perfectly fine. I still keep the house in order, pay the bills, help my wife out with things around the house. And even at work, I still handle all the technical parts of my job just like I always have. No one is complaining that my actual work is sloppy or disorganized. So, yeah, the rest of my life is completely normal.
Do you believe anyone besides your management is also targeting or plotting against you?

No, I don't think so. It's really just the management team at my office. I don't have any reason to believe anyone else is involved in this. My family, my friends, people outside of work... they're all fine. It's specifically the people handling the ticket rotations and the audits. Just them.
Has anyone you trust outside of work clearly shown you evidence that your managers are not setting you up?

Well, people outside of work don't really see the day-to-day systems, so they can't exactly show me evidence one way or the other. My family just listens, but they don't know the IT side of things. 

Honestly, that’s exactly why I’m here. For over a year now, I’ve been trying to get someone to actually take this seriously. Management keeps showing me system logs and telling me it’s all just standard policy, but I know what I'm looking at. The new ticket rotation and those security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me at work. I just need someone to finally understand what's going on.
Have you had any other unusual experiences besides this belief about your managers, such as feeling that TV, radio, or the internet were sending you special messages?

No, nothing like that. I don't think the TV or the internet is sending me messages. It's really just the situation at work with the ticket system and the audits. That's the only thing that's going on.
Did this belief about your managers start suddenly, or did it build up gradually over time?

It definitely built up gradually. I mean, it wasn't like I just woke up one day and thought they were out to get me. It started when they rolled out the new ticket rotation system about a year ago. At first, I just thought it was a buggy system, you know? I was getting the hardest, most time-consuming tickets, and I figured it was just bad luck or a glitch. But then the security audits started happening right after, and they were always focused on my work. Over a few months, I started looking closer at the patterns, and that's when I realized it wasn't a coincidence. So, yeah, it took some time for me to see the whole picture.
Have you held this belief that your managers are building a case against you continuously for at least three months?

Yes, definitely longer than three months. Like I said, it's been going on for over a year now... I'd say about a year and two months, exactly. It all really started when they brought in that new hybrid schedule and changed how the after-hours tickets were assigned. That's when it all began.
Has your management ever actually done anything openly that would make an ordinary person conclude they were trying to get you fired?

Well, not openly, no. I mean, that's exactly why I’m here. For over a year now, I’ve been trying to get someone to take this seriously. I know the new ticket rotation and these security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me at work. But whenever I point it out, management just keeps showing me system logs and saying it’s just standard policy. So an ordinary person just listening to their excuses might believe them, but they're definitely using those policies to build a case.
Have other people told you that your speech or thinking has become hard to follow or disorganized?

No, no one has ever said anything like that to me. Outside of this whole issue with the ticket rotation and the audits at work, everything else is completely normal. I still keep my house in order, I pay all the bills on time, I help my wife out with whatever she needs... and I still handle the technical parts of my job just fine. No one has ever told me my work is sloppy or that I'm disorganized or hard to follow. It's just this one specific situation with management that's the problem.
Do you think it is possible that you might be mistaken about your managers trying to build a case against you?

No, I don't believe I'm mistaken. Like I was just saying, that's exactly why I'm here. For over a year now, I've just been trying to get someone to take this seriously. I know what I'm seeing at work—the new ticket rotation, the security audits... they are absolutely being used to build a paper trail against me. Management can keep showing me system logs and telling me it's just standard policy all they want, but I know what's really going on. So, no, I'm not mistaken about this.
During this past year, have you had a period of feeling unusually depressed or unusually high or energized for days at a time?

No, I haven't felt anything like that. I haven't been depressed, and I haven't had any periods of feeling unusually energized or high, either. My mood has been pretty steady. I mean, obviously, I'm stressed and frustrated about what's happening at work, but it hasn't caused me to feel depressed or anything like you're describing. I just want this situation sorted out.
Over the past year, have you become much less interested in seeing other people or doing things you used to enjoy?

No, not at all. I still... I still enjoy my regular activities. My wife and I see our friends just as much as we used to, and I still spend my weekends tinkering with my ham radio setup in the garage. 

The stuff going on at the office is definitely on my mind a lot, of course, because I have to figure out how to handle it. But it hasn't made me want to hide away or stop doing the things I enjoy. Outside of that specific work situation, my life is completely normal.
Is there any part of what your managers are doing that you believe would be impossible by ordinary means?

No, I don't think there's anything impossible about it. It's just... well, it's just standard corporate maneuvering, really. They have access to the ticket system, they run the audits... they have all the tools they need to manipulate the paper trail. They're just using ordinary administrative processes to do it. There's no magic involved, just people in charge abusing their position.
Before all of this at work started, had you ever had any other fixed beliefs that other people said were not true?

No, never. I've never had anything like that happen before. I've always just... seen things the way they are. People haven't ever accused me of making things up or believing things that aren't true. This whole situation at work is the first time anyone has ever questioned my judgment like this, and it's only because I'm seeing what they're trying to hide. But before this? No, nothing at all.
Have you ever believed that anyone was trying to harm, monitor, or conspire against you in any situation other than this one at work?

No, just this. I mean, I've never had any reason to think someone was out to get me before. Like I said, my life has always been pretty straightforward. It's really just this one specific situation at the office with my managers. Outside of work, I don't have any problems with anyone, and I certainly don't think anyone else is monitoring me or conspiring against me. It's just them.
